standardName: Calculation of RWA for market risk
source: BIS Basel Framework MAR12 (Definition of trading desk); in-session Claude semantic pass

nodes.label: trading desk
nodes.definitionText: A group of traders or trading accounts that implements a well-defined business strategy within a clear risk management structure; the level at which internal-models approval is granted for market-risk capital.

nodes.label: trading account
nodes.definitionText: An indisputable and unambiguous unit of observation in accounting for trading activity; each is assigned to a single trading desk.

nodes.label: head trader
nodes.definitionText: The trader with direct oversight of the group of traders or trading accounts comprising a trading desk; a desk must have one and may have up to two.

nodes.label: trader mandate
nodes.definitionText: A well-defined mandate governing an individual trader's permitted activity within the trading desk's limits.

nodes.label: risk scope
nodes.definitionText: A trading desk's clearly defined risk scope consistent with its pre-established objectives, specifying its overall risk class and permitted risk factors.

nodes.label: trading limits
nodes.definitionText: Trading limits or directional exposures defined at trading-desk level from the business strategy, reviewed at least annually by senior management.

metadata.note: A trading desk may have at most two head traders.
Trading limits reviewed at least annually (interval <= 12 months).
Risk-management reports produced at least weekly (interval <= 1 week).
